Name: Zombie Night Horde
Author: LittleBoxOfEmo
Description:
[size=5]Zombie Night Horde[/size]

Staying up past 2:00 AM no longer makes your farmer politely faint. Instead, the night turns hostile: wave after wave of monsters closes in, each one bigger and meaner than the last. Fight your way to bed and sleep to end it, or get dragged into the dark and pay for it in the morning.

[size=4]What it does[/size]
[list]
[*]At 2:00 AM the vanilla collapse is cancelled and the horde begins.[/*]
[*]A new wave spawns roughly every 40 seconds. Each wave is larger than the last, and the monsters themselves ramp up: more health, more damage, and past a certain point they start outrunning you.[/*]
[*]The clock quietly loops through the small hours while the fight is on (it stays dark). Waves run on real time, not the in-game clock.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]The horde hunts you everywhere[/size]
[list]
[*]Waves spawn anywhere monsters normally can: your farm, the mines, Skull Cavern, the volcano dungeon, and modded combat maps.[/*]
[*]Only peaceful interiors (farmhouse, barn, coop, shops) are safe. Duck inside and the wave is held, but the horde keeps growing outside (you get a warning each time it does), and it rushes you within a few seconds of stepping back out.[/*]
[*]Changing location doesn't shake it. The swarm follows you through every door, and anything you leave behind is still there when you come back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Nightmare townsfolk[/size]
[list]
[*]About 1 in 10 of the horde (at least one every wave) shambles at you wearing a [b]villager's face[/b]. Your neighbours, lurching out of the dark.[/*]
[*]They're tougher than the regular monsters, wear their wounds, and burst apart when you drop them.[/*]
[*]No two of the same villager are ever alive at once.[/*]
[*]The [b]real NPCs are never touched[/b]. It's a bad dream, and everything is back to normal by morning. Adjust the mix, or turn it off entirely, in the config.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Ending the night[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Sleep in a bed[/b]: the horde disperses and you're paid "nightwatch" gold for every wave you actually fought. Waves you sat out indoors don't count.[/*]
[*][b]Get overwhelmed[/b] (health hits 0): the normal Stardew "passed out" morning, plus an optional extra money loss.[/*]
[*][b]Hold out until a set time[/b]: optional, off by default.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Multiplayer[/size]
Should work if every player has the mod installed. Not heavily tested, and the survival reward and on-screen alerts are still host-side only. There's a config option to disable the mod entirely in co-op.

[size=4]Configurable[/size]
Everything is tunable: trigger time, wave interval, wave size and growth, per-wave health/damage/speed scaling, the monster pool, the villager mix and cast, the undead tint colour, reward and death-penalty amounts, and an optional debug hotkey to summon a horde on demand.

Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and you can edit all of it in-game from the mod list. Otherwise, edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] (created on first launch).

[size=4]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*][i]Optional:[/i] Generic Mod Config Menu, for in-game settings[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI. Edit the settings to taste.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]This mod patches game code (Harmony) to intercept the pass-out. It should play nicely with most things, but anything else that changes the 2 AM / sleep behaviour may conflict.[/*]
[*]Designed for single player; multiplayer is supported but not really tested.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Notes[/size]
Preventing the collapse means the in-game clock never advances past 2 AM on its own. Sleeping is the intended way out.

Manifest.Description: Replaces the 2AM collapse with an ever-growing horde of monsters you have to fight off until you make it to bed (or dawn).
